parameters.query:
INSERT INTO audit_logs (clinic_id, actor_type, action, entity_type, payload, created_at)
VALUES (
  COALESCE({{ $('Normalize Input').item.json.clinic_id }}, 1)::bigint,
  'n8n',
  'dlq_crm_upsert_inbound',
  'workflow',
  jsonb_build_object('hint', 'See execution data for error details'),
  NOW()
)
RETURNING id;

UPDATE conversations
SET state = CASE
    WHEN '{{$json.finalIntent}}' = 'URGENT' OR {{$json.handoffRequired ? 'true' : 'false'}} THEN 'TRIAGE'
    ELSE 'ACTIVE'
  END,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = {{$json.conversation_id}} AND clinic_id = COALESCE({{$json.clinic_id}}, 1)::bigint
RETURNING id, state;

WITH new_case AS (
  INSERT INTO cases (
    clinic_id, patient_id, conversation_id, case_type, priority, status, summary, notes, source, opened_at, created_at, updated_at
  ) VALUES (
    COALESCE({{$json.clinic_id}}, 1)::bigint,
    {{$json.patient_id}},
    {{$json.conversation_id}},
    '{{$json.finalIntent}}',
    CASE {{$json.finalPriority}} WHEN 1 THEN 'high' WHEN 2 THEN 'normal' WHEN 3 THEN 'normal' ELSE 'low' END,
    'open',
    $${{$json.text}}$$,
    'Created by stability workflow',
    'n8n',
    NOW(), NOW(), NOW()
  )
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT id FROM new_case) AS case_id,
  COALESCE({{$json.clinic_id}}, 1)::bigint AS clinic_id,
  {{$json.patient_id}}::bigint AS patient_id,
  {{$json.conversation_id}}::bigint AS conversation_id,
  '{{$json.from}}' AS "from",
  $${{$json.text}}$$ AS "text",
  '{{$json.finalIntent}}' AS "finalIntent",
  {{$json.finalPriority}}::int AS "finalPriority",
  $${{$json.finalReply || ''}}$$ AS "finalReply",
  {{$json.handoffRequired ? 'true' : 'false'}} AS "handoffRequired",
  '{{$json.decisionSource || "rules"}}' AS "decisionSource",
  {{$json.aiValid ? 'true' : 'false'}} AS "aiValid",
  '{{$json.alertTo || ''}}' AS "alertTo";

  '{{$json.alertTo}}',
  'queued',
  'stability workflow alert',
  jsonb_build_object('decision_source', '{{$json.decisionSource}}'),
  NOW()
) RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO messages (
  clinic_id, conversation_id, patient_id, direction, text, intent, priority, is_urgent, dedup_skipped, source, payload, created_at
) VALUES (
  COALESCE({{$json.clinic_id}}, 1)::bigint,
  {{$json.conversation_id}},
  {{$json.patient_id}},
  'outbound',
  $${{$json.replyText}}$$,
  '{{$json.finalIntent}}',
  {{$json.finalPriority}},
  {{$json.finalIntent === 'URGENT' ? 'true' : 'false'}},
  false,
  'n8n',
  jsonb_build_object('decision_source', '{{$json.decisionSource}}', 'ai_used', {{$json.aiValid ? 'true' : 'false'}}, 'send_retries', {{$json.sendRetries || 0}}),
  NOW()
) RETURNING id;
